facts.text: Taihu is the third largest freshwater lake in China, in the Yangtze Delta, with its southern shore forming the Jiangsu-Zhejiang border
Famous for its fish and freshwater pearls; the Wuxi shore holds Yuantouzhu, Lingshan and Nianhua Bay

lake-tai.ticketUrl_evidence: Lake with no single steward; sold by many.
lake-tai.notes: No source states the lake itself is free; it has no gate, but ticketed scenic areas (Yuantouzhu 90) sit on its shore. Orchestrator decide whether to accept free/open. Visitor point is the shore pin, not the centroid.

facts.text: Peninsula on the northwest shore of Lake Tai, named for a rock shaped like a turtle's head; made a park in 1916
5A scenic area with over 10 spots, known for cherry blossoms from March to April
Adult ticket 90 yuan including the ferry

wuxi-2.ticketUrl_evidence: Official Chinese site linked from Wikipedia 'Yuantouzhu' external links; http and https return 502/fetch failed from scripts. Orchestrator to check in real browser.
wuxi-2.notes: Wikipedia article is titled Yuantouzhu (no 'Turtle Head Island (Wuxi)' article). Price is the Wuxi government listing; off-season 70 per a third-party site, not used.

facts.text: Classical garden inside Xihui Park near Huishan Temple, Ming dynasty in origin, with a national protected status since 1988
The Summer Palace's Xiequ Garden and Yuanming Yuan's Double-Crane House imitated it
Part of Huishan Ancient Town Scenic Area; the 70 yuan ticket covers the relics area and Xihui Scenic Area

wuxi-4.notes: Price is the Huishan Ancient Town combined ticket (the garden sits inside it, per Ctrip Q&A the garden needs the full 70 yuan ticket). A 2025-09 notice said the garden was under closed management: check before publishing. No separate official site found.

facts.text: Zen-themed town scenic area west of Lingshan Scenic Area in Binhu District
Adult ticket 140 yuan

wuxi-6.notes: Wikivoyage listing updated Oct 2023; not on the government price list. Official site not found (searches returned only aggregators). Wikipedia has no article.

facts.text: Chinese garden on the shore of Li Lake, named for Fan Li, a minister of the state of Yue
A 100-year-old white wisteria here is nicknamed the Money Tree
4A-rated; ticket 45 yuan high season, 30 low season

wuxi-8.notes: Range is low to high season.

facts.text: Academy founded in 1111 under the Northern Song, where Yang Shi taught for 18 years
Ming and Qing buildings with a stone arch, pool, Lize Hall and temple
Government list gives free entry (4A-rated)

wuxi-10.notes: Conflict: Wikivoyage says 5 yuan; the Oct 2025 government list says free, used here.

facts.text: Opened in 2008; holds nearly 40,000 relics, notably paintings and calligraphy, purple clay teapots and Huishan clay figurines
Hosts the Wuxi Chinese National Industry and Commerce Museum and the Wuxi Stele Museum
Free entry, Tuesday to Sunday

wuxi-12.notes: Entry free per government list and Wikivoyage. Official museum site not found.

facts.text: 4A ancient-town scenic area in Xishan District (Ehu town), open at all hours
Wikivoyage describes a very large old town developed from the former residence of Taibo

wuxi-14.notes: Government list gives Dangkou as free, open 24/7. Wikipedia 'Meicun' redirects to Wuxi, so wiki null. Pin note: the shard's wording 'at Meicun' is wrong; Dangkou is at Ehu town (the Meicun Taibo Temple is a separate site).

facts.text: 4A zoo and amusement park at the foot of Huishan, with over 1,000 rare animals from Africa, Asia and elsewhere
Runs giant panda research programmes
Ticket 100 yuan

facts.text: Sunac marine park in Binhu with sharks, rays and about 1,500 marine species planned
Adult ticket 150 yuan

wuxi-18.notes: Wikivoyage updated Dec 2023. A 2021 ticket site said 220 from; unverified. No official site found.

facts.text: Museum on the site of King Helu of Wu's capital, founded 514 BC, with a phoenix-shaped building opened in 2012
Exhibits relics, a 3D cinema and a multimedia hall
Ticket 120 yuan, Tuesday to Sunday

wuxi-20.notes: Government list 120; a 2017 China Daily piece said 60 (outdated). Wikipedia has no article (shard wiki 'Helu City' missing).

facts.text: One of China's earliest specialised ceramics museums, with 107 relics from Neolithic pottery to Ming and Qing zisha teapots
In Dingshu town, Yixing
Ticket 5 yuan

yixing-1.notes: Conflict: Wikivoyage (Sep 2023) says free; the Oct 2025 government list says 5, used here.

facts.text: Nature reserve in the Zhangzhu hills, with golden pine and magnolia trees unique to China, and a bicycle park
General entry is free; sightseeing car and bike hire cost extra

yixing-3.notes: Wikivoyage Sep 2023; no Wikipedia article for 'Longchi Mountain'. Not on the government list.

Ticket 110 yuan

facts.text: 3A ancient water town in Jiangyin with canals and old stone streets (Hebei street)
Wikivoyage: more than 2,000 years of history, well-preserved Jiangnan water-town architecture
Free, open 24 hours

facts.text: Former home of Liu Bannong, linguist and poet, and Liu Tianhua, erhu composer, at 49 Xiheng Street
Six exhibition halls on the three Liu brothers (Liu Bannong, Liu Beimao, Liu Tianhua)
